title: Isomonodromic deformations of Higgs bundles and characterization of the non-abelian Noether--Lefschetz locus
summary: Let $f:X\to S$ be a smooth proper family of smooth projective varieties. An irreducible complex local system on a fiber admits an isomonodromic deformation, hence determines a holomorphic section of the relative de Rham moduli space. Applying the relative non-abelian Hodge correspondence produces a real-analytic section $σ_{Dol}:S\to M_{Dol}(X/S)$ of the relative Dolbeault moduli space. In this paper, we investigate when this real-analytic section is holomorphic.
